title: Great cycling tour
text:
Very good experience! 
Cycled around the city edge and saw many highlights.
Good pace, in terms of stops, information, some free time (with the pidgeons and plaza d'españa), etc.
Karlos is professional, friendly, has good insights.
We continu ourselves with walking through the city with the map provided.

title: Incredible
text: Cristina Roldán made the reservation for us, and it went very well; she explained everything perfectly and not only that, she also advised us on places to eat. Thank you.

title: So much fun !!
text: Great 2.5 hours cycling around the city and learning about key building and points in the city.   Really fun and well worth it.  Enes was brilliant!
author: sjmacdonald34

title: Very good for bike hire
text: Excellent experience. We rented 2 bikes for 6 hours, with only 30 minutes notice. The bikes were ready, easy to ride and we had a nice day cycling around Seville on the bike paths and along the river to Alamillo park.
author: jacquelinedC2961QJ

title: Guided cycling tour
text: Very nice guide. The bike tour is rather simple (2 hours). Naturanada left us the bikes for the rest of the day.
author: Marie W

title: Great bike tour of seville
text: He knew his exact route and facts about the city. Very welcoming, and extremely kind. Would recommend. Exceeded my expectations entirely.

text: Karlos, very good guide, very good bike tour, you see the city using the bike lane and you are not missing anything, something light, fun and with lots of data, I recommend it 100%
